== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[Ultimate Freedom (Virtual Block 7)|Ultimate Freedom]], release 7.2 of [[Virtual Block 7]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of December 15, 2010". The file was created on 23 December 2010.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf VirtualBlock7_2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 300 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (1954&times;1204 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf Internet Archive].
